title: IMPLAN
description: Documented public economic impact software (IMPLAN Group) for the Economic Impact Modeler capability area.
body:
IMPLAN is a documented economic impact software from IMPLAN Group. The standard input-output modeling software estimating jobs, GDP, and tax impacts of projects and policies.

How it works: It works by projecting the logistic growth curve from the initial population toward the carrying capacity.

Documented uses of this capability area include city digital twins, power-grid planning, water-network operations, epidemic modeling, and disaster early warning.
